Upper Text: [When Digivolving][When Attacking][Once Per Turn] By trashing the top card of your security stack, you may play 1 yellow level 4 or lower card from your hand without paying the cost. Digimon played by this effect gain ＜Rush＞ for the turn.
[All Turns] All of your yellow Digimon gain ＜Barrier＞.
[Opponent's Turn] All of your opponent's Digimon with levels greater than or equal to the total cards in both players' security stacks gain ＜Security A. -2＞.
